answer_1.quote: We evaluate AdvSeq by extensive experiments on three generation tasks: text summarization, table-to-text, and dialogue generation.

answer_2.quote: For text summarization, since previous works report the unreliability of existing factual metrics, we report two different types of metrics, FactCC (CC) based on textual entailment and QuestEval (QE) based on question answering, for reliable comparison.

answer_4.quote: We recruit two human annotators from a professional data annotation team to evaluate our generated text in both informativeness and faithfulness.
answer_4.guideline: The annotators are asked to judge whether these generated texts are better than, tie with, or worse than the baseline model from the informativeness and faithfulness aspects, separately.
